record.field: Demo client for the Creative Studio walkthrough.
Saving starts with one small step you can take today.
Warm, plain-spoken, quietly confident. No jargon, no hard sell.

field.name: objective
field.p: Launch the bank's app-first savings account to first-time savers aged 22-35 in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad. Drive app installs and completed account openings in the first eight weeks.

field.name: audience
field.p: Salaried and self-employed young adults who have never held a savings product. They are comfortable on a phone, sceptical of banks, and put off by paperwork and minimum balances.

ul.li: Profit rate and terms legible in every execution.
Urdu and English versions of all copy lines.
No depiction of cash; app-first framing throughout.
Key visual, master plus three crops.
Social content set for the first four weeks.

record.field: The first step is the whole story.

field.name: rationale
field.p: Saving is not a lifestyle, it is a first step. We open on the smallest possible deposit and treat it as the moment everything changed. The account becomes the step, not the product.

field.name: visual_direction
field.p: Documentary-close portraiture, natural light, real interiors. Type sits quietly bottom-left. One warm accent against a neutral palette.

field.name: rationale
field.p: Frames the account as quiet preparation: the wedding, the shop, the degree. Strong emotionally but close to category convention, which is why it was parked rather than dropped.

field.name: visual_direction
field.p: Golden-hour vignettes, shallow depth of field, hand-lettered Urdu headlines.

field.name: rationale
field.p: Turns the rate table into people. Each number in the app is rendered as a portrait, so the maths is never abstract. Distinctive device, weaker on brand warmth on its own.

field.name: visual_direction
field.p: Editorial grid, oversized numerals, cut-out portraits, high contrast. Motion built on numerals resolving into faces.

record.field: Pehla Qadam + Numbers with a Face (combined)
One small step, and the number it becomes.

field.name: rationale
field.p: Keeps the first-step story of Pehla Qadam as the emotional spine and borrows the numeral-into-portrait device from Numbers with a Face as the campaign's signature. The step is the idea; the number is how we show it adding up.

field.name: visual_direction
field.p: Documentary portraiture as the base layer, with the oversized numeral treatment reserved for the pay-off frame in each execution.

field.name: feedback
field.p: Idea reads. Crop is too wide and the numeral fights the logo. Tighten to the hands, drop the numeral to the pay-off frame only, and set the rate line at the legal minimum size rather than larger.

field.name: feedback
field.p: Approved. Crop and type hierarchy are right. Release to the client with the Urdu line locked.

field.name: feedback
field.p: First twelve seconds are slow. Open on the deposit, not the walk-up. Re-cut and bring the numeral resolve forward to the 20 second mark.
